roleLabel: Ranged Frost Duelist — volley DPS that scales with Attack Speed and Stall
bestFor: Runs that want safe back-mid damage plus Frost application without committing a pure Mage
strength: Snowpiercer multi-hits from range, so Attack Speed and Stall upgrades multiply both damage and Frost stacks
weakness: Needs a front line; if packs dive her before volleys land she contributes almost nothing

howToPlay.early: Buy her when you already have someone eating first contact. Rank her only after one tanky piece is stable — she is a carry, not an opener.
howToPlay.mid: Push Attack Speed and Stall. The Falling Snow wants Stall windows so extra arrows Crit; Frostbite wants auto-attack volume. Pick one fantasy and feed it.
howToPlay.late: Commit either to Stall Crit volleys or permanent Warband stacking for the Duelist row. Do not split Shards across all three specs.
howToPlay.positioning: Back or far side lane with clear sightlines. Keep her off the dive tile; she wants to shoot, not tank the opener.

abilityNotes.Snowpiercer: Think of it as a short AS-scaling shotgun: more Attack Speed means more Frost and more total damage per cast. Pair AS relics before raw Attack greed.

specNotes.The Falling Snow: Take when you can hit Stall reliably — extra arrows plus Stall Crit is the cleanest “Karsu as main carry” path.
specNotes.The Warband: Take when you are committing multiple Duelists. Cast stacking that buffs the whole Duelist row is a board-wide investment, not a solo carry patch.
specNotes.The Frostbite: Take when fights last and she autos a lot. Extra Frost arrows punish long packs; weaker if she dies mid-cast cycle.

relicReasons.duelists-outbreak-banner-571: Class banner that amplifies the Duelist tag you already drafted her for.
relicReasons.martial-amplifier-2015: Generic martial amp — good glue when the shop refuses pure Duelist pieces.
relicReasons.duelists-fury-filigree-3010: Feeds the Attack Speed / aggression loop Snowpiercer wants.

faq.question: Is Karsu good in Guildrun?
faq.answer: Yes as a ranged Duelist carry when you can protect her. She is mediocre as your only early board piece. Shop check: do you already have a frontliner? If not, wait.

faq.question: What class is Karsu?
faq.answer: Duelist. Role focus: ranged Frost applicator who scales with Attack Speed and Stall.

faq.question: What relics work with Karsu?
faq.answer: Duelist banners/filigrees, Attack Speed / martial amplifiers, and anything that helps Stall windows if you took Falling Snow.

faq.question: How do you play Karsu?
faq.answer: Park her safely, stack Attack Speed, pick one Rank B path (Stall Crit, Warband team, or Frostbite autos), and only then dump Shards into ranks.

tips: If the shop offers Karsu with no tank in sight, skip — her power is behind a wall.
Warband is a team draft signal: if you will not run other Duelists, prefer Falling Snow or Frostbite.
